description.value: A free BC Hydro recreation campground on the shore of Upper Campbell Reservoir near Strathcona Provincial Park, accessible from Highway 28; amenities are unconfirmed so expect a basic experience with no guaranteed water or services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Hydro website fetched successfully but returned only site-wide navigation menus with no campground-specific content — the actual Strathcona Dam recreation page body did not render in the fetch. All factual claims therefore rest solely on OSM tags: tourism=camp_site confirms it is a campground, fee=no confirms free access, access=yes confirms public entry, and operator=BC Hydro identifies the managing body. No amenity details can be confirmed from either source.
concerns: Website fetch returned only BC Hydro site-wide navigation menus — the actual recreation area page body did not load, so no amenity details could be confirmed from the website.
No address, phone, or email available in OSM or website; contact information is very sparse.
Description includes minor inference about walk-in access model — this should be verified before publication.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free, publicly accessible BC Hydro-operated campsite in a remote reservoir setting on Vancouver Island is a genuinely useful waypoint for touring cyclists; the listing is legitimate and the OSM record is credible despite the website content not loading.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag fee=no is the sole basis for the free-access claim. Amenity details (water, toilets, bear caches, etc.) should be verified directly with BC Hydro or via a site visit before publishing a full listing.
